select "FSERIALNUM","FCATEGORYKEYWORDNUM","FCATEGORYKEYWORDDESC","FITFCONFIGID","FORDERBYKEYVALUE","FSYSTEM","FMANUFACTURERS","FIDSOURCE"

       fdescnum as PDFNAME,

         when PDFPATH like '%D:\%' then

         else
          PDFPATH
       end as PDFPATH,
       FUPDATE,
       FREPORTSTYLE
  FROM t_mss_itfview

SELECT b.frecordid FID,
         a.fmainid,
     ''  PATIENTID,
       FBIHID,
       FBINCU,
     c.fdesc  FITEMNAME,
     b.ffilename  PDFNAME,
      b.fcategory FDESCNUM,
      REPLACE(d.fpath,'d:','\\192.168.1.47')||'\'|| a.fpath||REPLACE(b.ffilename,'CDP','jpg') PDFPATH,
      fdate  FUPDATE,
      '住院' FREPORTSTYLE,
      '' FILESHAREIP,
      '' FILESHAREUSER,
       '' FILESHAREPWD
  FROM T_MSS_main a
  INNER JOIN t_mss_scanrecord b
  ON a.fmainid=b.fmainid
  INNER JOIN t_mss_category c
  ON c.fserialnum=b.fcategory
  INNER JOIN t_mss_sharepath d
  ON d.fsharepathid=a.fsharepathid

substr(fpatientid,1,8) as FBIHID,substr(fpatientid,10,1) as  FBINCU,
substr(rptname,12) as FITEMNAME,substr(rptname,12) as PDFNAME,substr(rptname,12) as FDESCNUM,

LEFT JOIN toffim b

SELECT t.fmrdid,t.fbihid,t.fbincu,t.fname,t.fidcd,t.fihdat,t.fodate,t.fioffi,t.fooffi,t1.ficd FROM tmrdde t
LEFT JOIN tmrdzd t1 ON t1.fmrdid=t.fmrdid AND t1.fzdtyp=1

 WHERE t.fodate<SYSDATE-7

SELECT
    FPATIENTID,
    fbihid,
    fbincu,
    fname,
    fsex,
    FAGE,
    FBDATE,
    FIHDAT,
    FIOFFI,
    FODATE,
    FOOFFI,
    fdesc
FROM (
    -- 内层查询添加行号，按FPATIENTID分组，按fodate降序（保留最新记录）
    SELECT
        a.hisid || '_' || a.fbincu AS FPATIENTID,
        a.fbihid,
        a.fbincu,
        a.fname,
        CASE
            WHEN a.fsex IN ('男', '1') THEN 1
            WHEN a.fsex IN ('女', '2') THEN 2
        END AS fsex,
        a.FAGE,
        a.FBDATE,
        a.FIHDAT,
        a.FIOFFI,
        a.FODATE,
        a.HLYDSP AS FOOFFI,
        a.RYBQMC AS fdesc,
        -- 核心：按FPATIENTID分组，给每组记录编行号，最新的fodate排第1
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.hisid || '_' || a.fbincu
            ORDER BY a.fodate DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM tmrdde a
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT fbihid || LPAD(fbincu, 2, '0') AS fmrdid_alias
        FROM T_MSS_ITFVIEW
    ) b ON a.fmrdid = b.fmrdid_alias
    WHERE a.RYBQWBM IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM t_mss_printlistqueue plq
        INNER JOIN t_mss_printqueuedetail pqd
          ON plq.fid = pqd.fprintlistqueueid
        WHERE pqd.ftype IN ('150','154','155','153')
          AND plq.fmrdid = a.fmrdid
      )
      AND a.fodate > sysdate - 30
) t
-- 只保留每组中第一行（即每个FPATIENTID仅一条记录）
WHERE t.rn = 1

SELECT b.frecordid,CASE WHEN (a.fmrdid IS  NULL OR a.fmrdid='') THEN a.fbihid||REPLACE(lpad(a.fbincu,3),' ','0') ELSE a.fmrdid END,a.fbihid,a.fbincu,a.fname,c.fserverip,replace(c.fpath,':','')||'\'||a.fpath||b.ffilename,b.fcategory,'JPG','' FROM t_mss_main a
INNER JOIN t_mss_scanrecord b ON a.fmainid=b.fmainid
INNER JOIN t_mss_sharepath c ON c.fsharepathid=a.fsharepathid

select t.FMRDID,t.FBIHID,t.FBINCU,t.FNAME,t.FAGE,FSEX,
( CASE WHEN FSEX IN ( '1') THEN '男' WHEN FSEX IN ('2')  THEN '女'
ELSE'未知' END) as  FSEXDESC,t.FIHDAT,t.FODATE,t.FIOFFI,d.fdesc as FIOFFIDESC,t.FOOFFI,d.fdesc as FOOFFIDESC  from tmrdde t
 left join Toffim c on c.foffn=t.Fooffi
left join Toffim d on d.foffn=t.fioffi

SELECT m.fmrdid 病案号, m.fbihid 住院号, m.fbincu 住院次数, m.fname 姓名, s.ffilename cdp文件, s.fremark 中文名, replace(s.ffilename, '.CDP','.PDF') pdf文件名,s.itfuploaddatetime 生成时间,P.FPATH || M.FPATH ||'PDF\'|| c.fdesc||s.fnum||'.PDF' 生成路径 FROM t_mss_scanrecord s INNER JOIN t_mss_main m ON m.fmainid=s.fmainid INNER JOIN t_mss_sharepath p ON m.fsharepathid=p.fsharepathid inner join t_mss_category c on s.fcategory=c.fserialnum WHERE s.isitfupload=1

SELECT M.Fmrdid, T.FMAINID, T.FRECORDID,T.FNUM, T.FCATEGORY,C.FDESC,FFILENAME, P.FPATH || M.FPATH || T.FFILENAME FPATH,P.FPATH || M.FPATH as folder FROM T_MSS_SCANRECORD T LEFT JOIN T_MSS_MAIN M ON T.FMAINID = M.FMAINID LEFT JOIN T_MSS_SHAREPATH P ON M.FSHAREPATHID = P.FSHAREPATHID LEFT JOIN T_MSS_CATEGORY C on T.FCATEGORY=C.FSERIALNUM  WHERE 1=1 and t.isitfupload=0

SELECT m.fmrdid 病案号, m.fbihid 住院号, m.fbincu 住院次数, m.fname 姓名, s.ffilename cdp文件, s.fremark 中文名, replace(s.ffilename, '.CDP','.PDF') pdf文件名,s.itfuploaddatetime 生成时间,P.FPATH || M.FPATH ||'PDF\'|| replace(s.ffilename,'.CDP','.PDF') 生成路径 FROM t_mss_scanrecord s INNER JOIN t_mss_main m ON m.fmainid=s.fmainid INNER JOIN t_mss_sharepath p ON m.fsharepathid=p.fsharepathid WHERE s.isitfupload=1
